claim: Interpretation: the chip channel has three layers - (1) direct sales by chipmakers to large OEMs/EMS; (2) authorized (franchised) distributors under written, usually non-exclusive, short-notice contracts with price protection and return rights, split into broadline (Arrow, Avnet, WPG, WT/Future), specialist (TTI) and high-service catalogue houses (DigiKey, Mouser, Farnell, RS); and (3) an open market of independent distributors and brokers without manufacturer contracts, plus authorized aftermarket firms (Rochester) for end-of-life parts.
